 Judgment

Challenging common judgment and award dated 17.01.2017 passed by Principal Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Kalaburagi, (for short 'tribunal') insofar as MVC.no.602/2013,
this appeal is filed.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri B. Ali Mohammad, learned counsel for appellant submitted that appeal was by claimant challenging impugned award only insofar as dismissal of claim petition against respondent no.4 - insurer and holding owner liable to pay compensation.
It was submitted that vehicle in question was TATA Indica Cab i.e., a light motor vehicle.
As per Ex.D3 - driving licence extract produced by insurer though had licence to drive light motor vehicle, he did not have 'transport' endorsement when Car was a Taxi.

Relying upon decision of this Court in case of Mohd. Haneef v/s Mallayya,
reported in 2015 SCC OnLine Kar 8168, tribunal exonerated insurer.

In view of said legal position, learned counsel sought for allowing appeal.
On other hand, Shri Sudarshan M, learned counsel for respondent no.2 - insurer sought to justify award.

4. Heard learned counsel, perused judgment and award.
5.

From above submission, since claimant is in appeal only insofar as liability is concerned, point that arises for consideration is:
"Whether dismissal of claim petition against respondent no.4 - insurer of TATA Indica Car, calls for interference?"
6.
While passing impugned award, tribunal specifically referred to Ex.D3 - driving licence extract and observed that driver of TATA Indica Car was in respect of Light Motor Vehicle non-transport.
Same was valid as on date of accident.

Merely on ground that there was no 'transport' endorsement and it was a Taxi, exoneration of respondent no.4 - insurer would not be justified in view of authoritative pronouncement by Hon'ble Supreme Court in NC: 2023:KHC-K:6480 Mukund Dewangan's case (supra).
Consequently, point for consideration is answered in favour of appellant.

7. In result, I pass following:
ORDER i. Appeal is allowed.
ii. Impugned judgment and award dated 17.01.2017 passed by Principal Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Kalaburagi, insofar as MVC.no.602/2013 is modified.
iii. Dismissal of claim petition against respondent no.4 - insurer is set-aside. iv. Respondent no.4 - insurer is also jointly and severally held liable to pay compensation to claimant.
v.
